    obj5_dict = f'<< /S {shared_stream_offset} /Length {len(obj5_stream_data)} >>'
    obj5 = f'{obj5_dict}\nstream\n'.encode() + obj5_stream_data + b'\nendstream'
    
    # Now build the PDF with correct offsets
    # Format: "N G obj" + content + "endobj"
    
    # Calculate offsets
    pdf_data = bytearray()
    pdf_data.extend(b'%PDF-1.4\n%\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF\n')
    
    # Object 1: Linearization dict
    obj1_start = len(pdf_data)
    # We'll fill in the variable parts later
    obj1_content = f'1 0 obj\n<< /Linearized 1 /L {{file_len}} /O 2 /E 100 /N 1 /T {{xref_offset}} /H [ {{hints_offset}} {len(obj5_stream_data)} ] /P 0 >>\nendobj\n'
    pdf_data.extend(obj1_content.encode())
    
    # Object 2: First page
    obj2_start = len(pdf_data)
    pdf_data.extend(f'2 0 obj\n{obj2}\nendobj\n'.encode())
    
    # Object 3: Pages
    obj3_start = len(pdf_data)
    pdf_data.extend(f'3 0 obj\n{obj3}\nendobj\n'.encode())
    
    # Object 4: Catalog
    obj4_start = len(pdf_data)
    pdf_data.extend(f'4 0 obj\n{obj4}\nendobj\n'.encode())
    
    # Object 5: Hints stream
    obj5_start = len(pdf_data)
    pdf_data.extend(f'5 0 obj\n{obj5_dict}\nstream\n'.encode())
    pdf_data.extend(obj5_stream_data)
    pdf_data.extend(b'\nendstream\nendobj\n')
    
    # XRef table
    xref_start = len(pdf_data)
    num_objects = 6
    xref = f'xref\n0 {num_objects}\n0000000000 65535 f \n'
    xref += f'{obj1_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj2_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj3_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj4_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj5_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    pdf_data.extend(xref.encode())
    
    # Trailer
    trailer_start = len(pdf_data)
    trailer = f'trailer\n<< /Size {num_objects} /Root 4 0 R >>\n'
    pdf_data.extend(trailer.encode())
    pdf_data.extend(b'startxref\n')
    pdf_data.extend(f'{xref_start}\n'.encode())
    pdf_data.extend(b'%%EOF\n')
    
    # Now fix up object 1 with correct offsets
    file_len = len(pdf_data)
    obj1_fixed = f'1 0 obj\n<< /Linearized 1 /L {file_len} /O 2 /E 100 /N 1 /T {xref_start} /H [ {obj5_start} {len(obj5_stream_data)} ] /P 0 >>\nendobj\n'
    
    # Replace object 1 content
    pdf_data[:len(obj1_fixed)] = obj1_fixed.encode()
    
    return bytes(pdf_data)
